{
    public class TranscodingJobTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public void Stop_ShouldLogInformationWhenKillingProcess()
        {
            // Arrange
            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger<TranscodingJob>>();
            var transcodingJob = new TranscodingJob(loggerMock.Object)
            {

                    {
                        FileName = "ffmpeg",
                        RedirectStandardInput = true,
                        UseShellExecute = false

            transcodingJob.Process.Start();

            // Act
            transcodingJob.Stop();

            // Assert
            loggerMock.Verify(
                logger => logger.LogInformation(
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.IsAny<It.IsAnyType>(),
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception, string>>(),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception, string>>()),
                Times.Exactly(2));
        }
    }
}

using System;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;

namespace MediaBrowser.Controller.MediaEncoding;

/// <summary>
/// Class TranscodingThrottler.
/// </summary>
public sealed class TranscodingThrottler : IDisposable
{
    private readonly SemaphoreSlim _semaphore;
    private readonly CancellationTokenSource _cancellationTokenSource;

    /// <summary>
    /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="TranscodingThrottler"/> class.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="maxConcurrentTranscodings">The maximum number of concurrent transcodings.</param>
    public TranscodingThrottler(int maxConcurrentTranscodings)
    {
        _semaphore = new SemaphoreSlim(maxConcurrentTranscodings);
        _cancellationTokenSource = new CancellationTokenSource();
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Stops the throttler.
    /// </summary>
    public Task Stop()
    {
        _cancellationTokenSource.Cancel();
        return Task.CompletedTask;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Waits for a transcoding slot to become available.
    /// </summary>
    public Task WaitForSlotAsync()
    {
        return _semaphore.WaitAsync(_cancellationTokenSource.Token);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Releases a transcoding slot.
    /// </summary>
    public void ReleaseSlot()
    {
        _semaphore.Release();
    }

    /// <inheritdoc />
    public void Dispose()
    {
        _semaphore.Dispose();
        _cancellationTokenSource.Dispose();
    }
}
